items.guidance: In the Express app, check the main server/app file for any existing lightweight route (for example an API status or ping route) before adding one. If none exists, register the GET route on the Express app before any passport/auth, host-check, or redirect middleware, and confirm it responds on port 3000.

Check whether connect-mongo is actually wired into the Express session setup on a runtime path and whether MONGO_URL is read by production code or only by legacy config or env examples. Report the file and usage you find, and whether the app's primary data layer already uses PostgreSQL.

Locate where bull queues are created and where their process handlers are registered, and check whether the web server entry imports them at startup. Report whether a separate worker entry point or package.json script exists and which command would start it; also note whether the bull queues need a Redis connection setting, since the facts list none.
